reason: The old methods are kept as obsolete wrappers delegating to the new global-namespace extensions with identical logic, so existing code compiles and behaves the same, though the new global-namespace static class with no namespace could theoretically collide with user-defined helpers or cause ambiguous extension method resolution in downstream projects.
